help.keyboard: Keyboard dictation types directly into your note. Use your keyboard’s microphone key or your system’s dictation shortcut. On Mac, enable Dictation in System Settings → Keyboard.

status.ready: Note ready. Press your keyboard’s microphone key or dictation shortcut to speak.

error.notAllowed: Microphone or speech access was blocked. Allow microphone access in your browser and system settings, then try again.
error.audioCapture: No microphone is available. Connect or enable a microphone, then try again.
error.noSpeech: No speech was detected. Try again and speak after the button says Listening.
error.network: This browser could not reach its speech recognition service. Try Chrome with an internet connection, or use keyboard dictation below.
error.languageNotSupported: This browser does not support dictation in your current language. Use keyboard dictation below.
error.timeout: Speech recognition could not start in this browser. Try Chrome, or use keyboard dictation below.
error.start: Speech recognition could not start in this browser. Try Chrome, or use keyboard dictation below.
error.unsupported: This browser does not support speech recognition. Open the journal in Chrome, or use keyboard dictation below.
